description: This file is the main source code for the Kint debugging tool, providing class definitions, configuration, and utility functions for variable output and stack trace visualization.

classes.name: Kint
classes.description: Main class providing static methods and properties for debugging, including dump and trace functionalities, path shortening, and trace analysis.

methods.name: enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables Kint, optionally forcing a specific rendering mode or returning the current mode.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Outputs a stack trace, with optional custom trace data.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs detailed information about variables, supporting multiple formatting modifiers and output options.

methods.name: shortenPath
methods.description: Creates a relative or shortened version of a file path based on application root directories or common path segments.

methods.name: getIdeLink
methods.description: Generates hyperlink for IDE integration based on file and line parameters.

methods.name: _showSource
methods.description: Displays source code snippets around a specific file and line number with optional padding.

methods.name: _getCalleeInfo
methods.description: Analyzes a stack trace to identify the caller of Kint functions and extract call details.

methods.name: _removeAllButCode
methods.description: Strips comments and non-code tokens from PHP source code to facilitate parsing.

methods.name: _stepIsInternal
methods.description: Checks if a stack trace step pertains to internal Kint methods.

methods.name: _parseTrace
methods.description: Processes raw trace data into a structured, filtered trace array with source code snippets.
